name: The Red Ballet
source:
Sid is a rat working a dead-end job at the corner store. But on the other side of the street is the ballet theatre, The Red Ballet. He dreams of being on that stage with the graceful ballerinas and ballerinas, but who would want to see a rat flail around his ugly tail? 

His life starts to change when he meets Emilio, the easygoing goat stagehand, and the intimidating bear Misha, who runs the ballet. 

In a world that does not look kindly on the big dreams of a small rodent, can Sid find his swan feathers, or will he remain the simple prey the world tells him he is? 

And can he survive the dance of The Red Ballet's sinister secrets?

[From [url=https://pinknarcissus.itch.io/the-red-ballet]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
席德是一只在街角小店打着没前途零工的老鼠，而在街道对面，便是芭蕾舞剧院“红芭蕾”。他梦想有朝一日能与优雅的芭蕾舞者们同台起舞，可谁会愿意看一只老鼠甩着丑陋的尾巴在台上手忙脚乱呢？

当他结识了随和好相处的山羊舞台工作人员埃米利奥，以及掌管整个舞团、不怒自威的巨熊米沙后，他的生活开始悄然改变。

在这个对小小啮齿动物的远大梦想冷眼相待的世界里，席德究竟能否披上属于自己的天鹅羽衣，还是只能永远当世人眼中卑微的猎物？

他又能否在“红芭蕾”险恶秘密交织的舞曲中全身而退？

[摘自[url=https://pinknarcissus.itch.io/the-red-ballet]Itch.io[/url]]
